title: What the Middleman Delivers: Answer Behavior, Tool Permissions, and Billed Usage in LLM API Relays
abstract: arXiv:2611.07650v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Third-party application programming interface (API) relays offer access to large language models (LLMs), often at lower prices. Users depend on these services for model quality, instruction compliance, and accurate billing. However, existing studies leave unclear whether relays meet these expectations together. We test 20 relays offering GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5. First, we compare answers to knowledge questions with batch-matched official responses. In our first-round sample, the analysis flags 7/10 low-price and 2/10 same- or higher-price relays for behavioral differences. On retesting 35 pairs, seven gain or lose a flag under the original rules, and six under matched correction families. Because answer comparisons cannot reveal every delivery problem, we examine returned content and tool permissions. No injection is confirmed in 3,332 screened responses to a fixed, non-adversarial code and setup workload, yet four relays return

translated_title: 中间商究竟交付了什么：LLM API中转服务中的回答行为、工具权限与计费用量
translated_abstract: 第三方应用程序接口（API）中转服务以通常更低的价格提供大型语言模型（LLM）的访问。用户依赖这些服务来保障模型质量、指令遵循能力以及准确的计费。然而，现有研究并未澄清中转服务能否同时满足这些期望。我们测试了20个提供GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5的中转服务。首先，我们将知识类问题的回答与批量匹配的官方响应进行比较。在第一轮样本中，分析标记出7/10的低价中转服务和2/10的同价或更高价中转服务存在行为差异。在重新测试35对样本时，按照原始规则有七个服务被新增或撤销标记，而按照匹配的修正族规则则有六个。由于回答比较无法揭示所有交付问题，我们进一步检查了返回内容和工具权限。在针对固定的、非对抗性的代码与配置工作负载筛选的3,332条响应中，未确认存在注入行为，但有四个中转服务返回……
tldr: 本研究对20个提供GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5的第三方LLM API中转服务进行系统性测试，发现约半数低价中转服务的回答行为与官方模型存在差异，并通过检查返回内容、工具权限与计费用量揭示了中转服务在交付质量上的不可靠性。
en_tdlr: This study systematically tests 20 third-party LLM API relays offering GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, finding that about half of the low-price relays exhibit behavioral differences from official model responses, and further examines returned content, tool permissions, and billed usage to reveal reliability issues in relay-based service delivery.
